validation_scope: Controlled offline tests only. No model inference, real account mutations, network calls or desktop actions were executed for V2/D.
atomic_admission: The provider guard is entered at the service durable admission boundary and at the dedicated writer claim. Account epoch, account fingerprint, cancellation and remaining deadline are rechecked. A committed admission may precede physical completion; no rollback is claimed.
lock_order: service lock then brief provider guard; provider never holds its lock while calling service dispatcher or waiting for pipe completion.
transport: Single stdin owner, bounded queue and caller wait, deadline check before claim, reply wait recalculated after write/flush. Uncertain messages are not replayed. Only the owned child is terminated.
cleanup: One absolute three-second shutdown budget reserves terminate/kill waits; exhausted write budgets do not add an extra reap wait. Scheduling and OS calls are not hard real-time guarantees.
local_disconnect: Persisted Axx-local opt-out. No account/logout RPC. Explicit reconnect/login is required to opt in again.
service_validation: core-revision2-final.log/result.json records the independently run 21-test service suite on the service hashes above.
historical: Revision C evidence remains historical. Previous real inference/interrupt evidence predates V2/D and does not verify this exact source.
